rationale:
Scored with a symbol-level model built from the three candidates' models, the digest and every research note's critic additions, then checked by script (sizes, item counts, edges, shared functions, at most one _generate_app_source, _make_figure_body, scheme-regeneration and axis-finisher editor per batch). Part labels below (3a, 17b, ...) are P1 item parts; Sn is a final section number.

Candidate 1 (dependency): the best edge set (P1.17a before 3a, then 17b, 23a, 3b; 13a after 4a; P1.25 split so the 26 schemes land before every regeneration) and the most precise scopes, 22 batches. Faults: under the critics' symbol lists four batches share a function (P1.32/23a and 31a/9a in _generate_app_source, 20b/18a in _make_figure_body, P1.6/9a in _dash_parse_plot_opts' pending list); P1.27 accepts ; & | < > in batch 3 while P1.29's opener lands in batch 7 (an M11 gap); about seven batches carry three unrelated topics.
Candidate 2 (parallel): good merge hygiene (per-section anchors, two-commit sections), 21 batches. Faults: 2a/P1.5 share _dash_finish_secondary_axes, P1.16/14a map_scatteri, 17b/P1.24 map_bar and map_dropline, 15c/13b _apply_colorvar; P1.27 before P1.29; P1.25 whole in batch 3, so third-party scheme colours wait for the colour grammar.
Candidate 3 (value): security-forward order (P1.29 before P1.27, TeX inert early) and clear themes, but keeping P1.9, 17, 18, 20 and 21 whole forces collisions: P1.9/4a share nine mappers, P1.9/15 and P1.29/P1.32 _generate_app_source, P1.27/26b _dash_launch_app, 12a/2b map_bar, 12a/1b _dash_validate_value, P1.7/8a _dash_process_segment, P1.17/P1.20 _dash_refinish_axes, and two regenerators in one batch (14b/21b).
All three missed critic findings that add edits: 14a's ten colour-reading mappers, 8b's derived-mapper tails, 12a's 11 _apply_mlabel_opts call sites, 9a's pending-list entry, 8a's _make_figure_body routing and the direct %# colour sites.

Synthesis: candidate 1's sections, edges and scopes; candidate 3's security order (S4 CSP and opener in batch 2, before S12 widens saving(); S9 TeX inert in batch 3) and its P1.11 a/b split; candidate 2's per-section anchors in the foundation and its two-commit structure for P1.6, P1.7, P1.10, P1.16, P1.24, P1.30 and P1.33. Reassigned: the served launch line to S12 (it owns _dash_build), the D5 %# sites from 13a (S30) to 13b (S43), per-y named-style lists to 14a (S32), the default 01jan1960 base to 17b (S27), and 11b's wiring to S9's pass so S29 edits neither _build_sources_and_figures nor _generate_app_source. Added edges: 18b after 3b (add unions with the date ticker), 13b after 18a (one owner of bare *# at the new axis colour sites), 9a after 8b (type refusal on the recast type).

Result: 58 sections (56 fix sections; every P1.1-P1.35 covered; 20 items split, each L/XL or, for P1.17 and P1.25, forced apart by dependencies; P1.34 and P1.35 shrunk per M4 and M2, P1.22 a disposition per M12), 22 batches, at most 3 sections and 3 items each, no two sections in a batch editing the same function, every dependency in an earlier batch, so no batch is serialised. Each batch has at most one of the 17 _generate_app_source editors, one scheme regenerator (merged last) and one axis-finisher editor. Red sections (S21, S44, S57) sit one per batch with lighter partners; S57 is alone. Batch 13 holds two sections because every other ready section collides with one of them.
